notes: 0.163.0 and 0.164.0: tools arrive as namespaces inside an input item of type additional_tools (functions, clock, collaboration); the shell tool is a grammar-typed custom tool named exec (exec_command with a config.toml model, shell in older versions), so tool_present is used instead of a tool set. Headers, identity and habits are identical on the first turn and after the tool call. The built-in openai provider ignores OPENAI_BASE_URL since 0.16x; captures need a custom model provider with base_url.
